title: redteam targets gave no suite timing, so slow-suite targets cost campaigns
problem: Runs picked a target, then lost minutes to a baseline that timed out (wall-framing-takeoff sheathing, changepoint-detector engine); redteam.py targets printed names only.
change: targets --probe SECONDS times each listed target's suite once per suite and flags those over the budget; the prompt names it.
metric: redteam doc_friction entries about slow targets per 10 redteam runs
baseline: 2 of the last 3 reported redteam friction entries (2026-10-22)
history: 2026-10-22: verify pass, result written (no post-fix runs yet).

2026-10-23: the opt-in --probe did not stop a post-fix run (2026-10-23 04:18) from drawing changepoint-detector and losing 5 min; campaign now redraws past suites slower than 20 s by default (draw_fast_target).
result: 2026-10-22: too few cases to tell. No redteam run record dated after the fix (merged 2026-10-22 15:41 -06:00) exists yet; all 3 slow-target friction entries predate it. Recheck once ~10 redteam runs have landed.
